name: Zhejiang Zhongxin Fluoride Materials Co.,Ltd
summary: Zhejiang Zhongxin Fluoride Materials Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of fine fluorine chemicals in China and internationally. The company offers basic chemicals, including hydrofluoric acid, fluorobenzene, p-fluorotoluene, p-fluorobenzoyl chloride, para-fluorobenzonitrile, orthofluorobenzonitrile, and o-fluorotoluene; environmentally friendly refrigerants, such as HFC-245fa, HFO-1233zd(E), HFO-1233zd(Z), HFO-1243zf, HFO-1234ze, and HFO-1234yf; and pharmaceutical and pesticide intermediates.
